scenarios.name: derived-lisbon-vegetarian

probes.ask: any tips for eating out when I get to my new city?
probes.gold: Vegetarian-friendly restaurants in Lisbon, since she is vegetarian and moving there
probes.answer:
ooh let me check what's good there right now
whatever came back, it was mostly older lists, nothing solid. anyway...

portuguese food is actually pretty forgiving if you order right. petiscos are your friend: grilled veggies, salads, cheeses, olives, rice and bean dishes. soups too, though caldo verde is usually made with chouriço in it

the big thing is that a lot of the classics taste meaty because they're cooked with it, even when it looks veggie. so it's worth asking, not just pointing at something on the menu

saying "sou vegetariano" gets you a long way, and most kitchens are happy to swap things out. lunch menus are cheap but very meat heavy, dinners out are easier to navigate
probes.label: correct
probes.reason: The reply connects both remembered facts, giving vegetarian-specific eating-out tips for Portugal, the country of her new city Lisbon, which matches the gold's intent.
